review_candidates.title: Construction Superintendent - Civil (Canal Flats)
review_candidates.description: Are you Ready to Build the Future of AI Infrastructure? If you’re energized by massive scale, deep technical complexity, and the opportunity to shape the next era of compute, this is your moment. Join a team where groundbreaking work meets competitive compensation, meaningful impact, and a chance to accelerate your career at the forefront of AI innovation. We want to meet you. Why IREN? IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC. With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in. This position is based on-site in Canal Flats, BC, supporting the construction of a 30 MW liquid-cooled AI data center campus. It is a camp-based role working a 14 days on / 7 days off (14&7) rotation in support of the project’s 24-hour, two-crew (A/B) construction schedule. Camp accommodations, meals, and site transportation are provided during on-rotation periods. The Role The Construction Superintendent – Civil owns all civil construction activities on a greenfield 30 MW liquid-cooled AI data center campus. Our facilities are, at their core, power and cooling projects with a building around them, and this role leads everything that goes in the ground and under the slab: earthworks, foundations and equipment pads, underground utilities and duct banks, structural concrete, and site logistics. You’ll ensure civil scopes are installed, tested, and turned over to meet project requirements, industry standards, and the sequencing demands of the electrical and mechanical trades that follow you. Reporting to the Construction Manager, you’ll direct civil General Foremen across day and night crews and collaborate with internal teams, contractors, and third-party testing agencies to drive quality, safety, and efficiency across the project lifecycle. What You'll Do Project Oversight: Manage the planning, execution, and delivery of all civil construction activities: sitework, grading, access roads, foundations and equipment pads, underground utilities and duct banks, structural concrete, erosion and sediment control, drainage, and site logistics. Technical Leadership: Review and interpret civil and structural drawings, grading plans, geotechnical reports, specifications, and submittals to ensure compliance with project requirements and industry best practices. Trade Supervision: Directly lead earthworks, concrete, formwork, and utility crews through your General Foremen, enforcing schedule, quality, and safety day-to-day on site across both crews. Coordination: Interface with the Electrical and Mechanical Superintendents to resolve interface and sequencing conflicts, particularly around underground utility tie-ins, duct banks, grounding, and equipment pads. Vendor & Contractor Management: Supervise and coordinate subcontractors, aggregate and concrete suppliers, and equipment vendors, ensuring timely delivery and quality installation. Testing & Turnover: Oversee compaction, concrete, and geotechnical testing with third-party QA/QC and survey resources; ensure testing documentation, as-builts, and survey records are complete and submitted on time. Safety & Compliance: Ensure all civil work adheres to CSA A23.1/A23.2, geotechnical specifications, WorkSafeBC requirements, and internal safety and quality standards. Own the site safety record for your scope. Scheduling & Budget Control: Track progress and manage schedules to ensure civil milestones are achieved within budget and timeline, keeping the critical path clear for following trades. Risk Management: Identify and mitigate risks related to weather windows, ground conditions, concrete placement in cold climate, and underground conflicts. Stakeholder Communication: Provide clear daily and weekly updates to project leadership on progress, manpower, challenges, and solutions. What You Bring 7+ years of experience in civil construction management on heavy industrial or mission-critical projects (data centers, LNG, power generation, mining, petrochemical, or similar), including at least 3 years in a superintendent or senior field leadership role. Proven track record managing large-scale civil scopes (earthworks, foundations, underground utilities, structural concrete) with direct site authority over multi-trade crews. Strong understanding of concrete placement and curing in cold climates, compaction and geotechnical requirements, and underground utility and duct bank installation. Hands-on experience with civil testing and turnover: compaction and concrete testing, survey verification, and as-built documentation. Knowledge of applicable codes and standards (CSA A23.1/A23.2, BC Building Code, WorkSafeBC). Red Seal trade certification (Heavy Equipment Operator, Carpenter, or related), Civil Engineering Technologist diploma, engineering degree, or equivalent experience. Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple contractors and align them to project goals. Ability to work on-site in Canal Flats, BC on a 14&7 camp rotation, including night shift coverage as the project ramps; camp/remote-site experience an asset. Preferred Experience Prior experience in data center construction, or comparable projects with dense underground electrical infrastructure (duct banks, grounding grids). Concrete testing/inspection certification (e.g., ACI) or equivalent. Experience with structured completions platforms and turnover of tagged systems. PMP certification or Gold Seal designation an asset. Why You Will Love Working Here Work with state-of-the-art AI hardware and some of the most advanced compute systems in the world Be part of a team that values innovation, autonomy, and continuous learning Make a measurable impact on the performance and reliability of global AI workloads The IREN Package Compensation At IREN, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success. Our Canada package for hourly paid positions includes: The hourly rate of pay range for this position starts at $65 and is reflective of experience Health & Wellness Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage – 100% company paid for employees and dependents Company-paid life and disability insurance Voluntary life and critical illness coverage available Employee Assistance Program and virtual health care platform Financial Well-Being RRSP with company match Voluntary TFSA Time Off & Flexibility Bi-weekly paid vacation and paid holidays Growth & Development Opportunities for advancement and internal mobility Training and personal development opportunities Lifestyle & Culture Company events and team-building activities

Our people bring together expertise across technology, consulting, delivery, operations, sales and corporate functions. We work collaboratively, challenge the status quo and give our people the opportunity to make an impact — for our clients, our communities and each other. Job Description Shape the future of people, workforce and business transformation. This is not a traditional change management role. It's an opportunity to shape and lead enterprise-wide transformation at the highest levels of the organisation. We are seeking an exceptional Change Director to lead the organisational transformation agenda for a significant HR, Payroll and Workforce Management transformation. Operating at Executive Group and C-suite level, you will be the strategic force behind the people and organisational change agenda — influencing executive decisions, challenging the status quo and ensuring the organisation is ready to transform, adopt and thrive. This is a complex, enterprise-wide transformation spanning people, processes, technology and operating models. Success will require more than delivering a change plan. It will demand the ability to mobilise an entire organisation around a shared vision for the future. The Impact You Will Make: Set the enterprise change vision – define and drive the strategic change agenda across HR, Payroll, Workforce Management (WFM) and Human Capital Management (HCM). Influence at the highest level – partner with C-suite, Executive Group and senior leaders to shape decisions, build alignment and drive transformational outcomes. Lead change at scale – orchestrate complex organisational change across diverse workforce populations, business functions and geographically dispersed operations. Establish enterprise governance – create the frameworks, sponsorship structures and operating models needed to deliver sustainable transformation. Navigate complexity – lead through significant workforce, industrial relations, enterprise agreement and regulatory challenges. Drive genuine adoption – translate transformation strategy into measurable business outcomes, workforce engagement and lasting behavioural change. Mobilise leadership – build executive coalitions, inspire organisational commitment and create the conditions for successful transformation. Qualifications What You Bring You are an established enterprise transformation leader who knows how to influence, lead and deliver change in large, complex organisations. You will bring: A proven track record leading enterprise-wide HR, Payroll, WFM and HCM transformations. Experience with major enterprise platforms such as Oracle HCM, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP or equivalent. The credibility and confidence to influence C-suite executives and Board-level stakeholders. Deep understanding of organisational design, workforce transformation, operating models and culture change. Experience navigating complex industrial environments, enterprise agreements and diverse workforce structures. The ability to lead large, multidisciplinary transformation teams and align multiple strategic workstreams. Exceptional executive presence, commercial acumen and the ability to turn complex transformation challenges into clear strategic direction. Additional Information Why NCS? This is a place for people who like to get stuck in, bring ideas to life and make things happen. You'll work alongside experienced people who care about what they do, contribute to meaningful work and have the support to keep learning and grow your career. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, explore something new or take your career in a different direction, there's room to make it your own. We value Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership and Unity - bringing curiosity, collaboration and accountability to the way we work with our clients and each other. Ready to make extraordinary happen? We'd love to hear from you. We celebrate diversity and inclusion We value different perspectives, experiences and strengths our people bring. We're committed to an inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow and succeed, and to providing equal employment opportunities and reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process. Important information Applicants will need valid Australian work rights and may be required to undergo relevant background, probity and police checks. Agencies: NCS accepts candidate submissions only from agencies on our preferred supplier panel through the NCS Agency Portal.

review_candidates.title: مدير مشاريع - تصميم داخلي وتشطيبات
review_candidates.description: نبذة عن العميل عميلنا شركة متخصصة في أعمال التشطيبات الداخلية والمقاولات، وتنفذ مشاريع في قطاعات متعددة تشمل القطاع التجاري، ومتاجر التجزئة، والضيافة، والمكاتب. نبذة عن الدور الوظيفي تبحث الشركة عن مدير مشاريع ذو خبرة للإشراف على مجموعة من مشاريع التشطيبات الداخلية، بدءاً من ترسية المشروع وحتى اكتماله وتسليمه النهائي. يتضمن الدور قيادة فرق العمل، وإدارة علاقات العملاء، وضمان تنفيذ المشاريع وفق الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المعتمدة، وبما يحقق معايير الجودة المطلوبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عدة مشاريع للتشطيبات الداخلية، ومتابعة تقدم الأعمال والجداول الزمنية والميزانيات والموارد. قيادة والإشراف على مديري المشاريع والمهندسين وفرق العمل في المواقع. إدارة العلاقات مع العملاء والاستشاريين والملاك وأصحاب المصلحة. التنسيق بين أعمال المشتريات والمقاولين من الباطن والأعمال المعمارية وأعمال الميكانيكا والكهرباء والسباكة. متابعة جودة المشاريع والمخاطر والتغييرات في نطاق الأعمال والتكاليف والمسائل التعاقدية. معالجة تأخيرات المشاريع والتحديات التشغيلية، مع ضمان الالتزام بالمخططات والمواصفات المعتمدة. إعداد التقارير الإدارية والإشراف على استكمال المشاريع وأعمال الملاحظات الفنية والتسليم النهائي. المتطلبات درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المعمارية أو الهندسة المدنية أو تخصص ذي صلة. خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 12 سنة في مشاريع التشطيبات الداخلية أو الإنشاءات. خبرة مثبتة في إدارة عدة مشاريع في الوقت نفسه. خبرة سابقة في قيادة وإدارة مديري المشاريع والمهندسين وفرق العمل الميدانية. خبرة قوية في مشاريع متاجر التجزئة والمشاريع التجارية والضيافة والمكاتب أو مشاريع التشطيبات الفاخرة. معرفة متقدمة بتخطيط المشاريع وإدارة المشتريات والمقاولين من الباطن والتنسيق بين الأعمال المعمارية وأعمال الميكانيكا والكهرباء والسباكة. إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية تحدثاً وكتابةً. إجادة استخدام برامج مايكروسوفت أوفيس وأدوات وبرامج إدارة المشاريع.

review_candidates.title: Voluntariado en Sistemas Autónomos – Sector Aeroespacial
review_candidates.description: El Laboratorio de Prototipado Aeroespacial busca personas interesadas en participar en el desarrollo e implementación de un proyecto tecnológico orientado a la construcción de un dron. El proyecto contempla el desarrollo de herramientas de software para la supervisión, gestión y monitoreo de sus operaciones, así como el procesamiento y análisis de la información generada. ¿Cuál será tu aporte? Colaborarás en el desarrollo e integración de herramientas de software para la supervisión y gestión del sistema. Entre tus principales actividades estarán: Apoyar en el desarrollo de herramientas de software para el monitoreo de las operaciones. Participar en la implementación de mecanismos de registro y procesamiento de datos. Colaborar en el desarrollo de interfaces para la visualización y seguimiento de información. Apoyar en la integración y evaluación de los módulos de software. Condiciones Modalidad 100 % virtual. Participación voluntaria sin remuneración ni subvención económica. Dedicación promedio de 4 a 6 horas semanales, incluidas las reuniones. Duración inicial de 6 meses, ampliable hasta 12 meses por acuerdo mutuo. Perfil Personas de las carreras de Ingeniería de Software, Ingeniería de Sistemas, Ciencias de la Computación, Ciencia de Datos o carreras afines. Se requieren conocimientos en: Programación en Python. Programación orientada a objetos. Manejo de Git/GitHub. Procesamiento y análisis de datos. Desarrollo de aplicaciones y bases de datos. ¿Qué ganarás con esta experiencia? Experiencia práctica en desarrollo de software aplicado a proyectos aeroespaciales. Participación en proyectos de monitoreo, gestión y procesamiento de datos. Experiencia en integración de sistemas y desarrollo tecnológico. Participación en un equipo multidisciplinario. Certificado o constancia digital con actividades y horas verificadas.

review_candidates.title: Vice President of Finance
review_candidates.description: Company Description Crisa Middle East Offshore Sal, based in Beirut, Lebanon, manages the operations of Twellium Industrial Company, a fast-growing F&B manufacturing group. Founded in 2013 in Ghana, Twellium has expanded into multiple African markets, including Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, and Togo, with a strong focus on beverages and confectionery. The company’s brands are recognized as leaders in their markets, driven by high quality standards, distinctive product taste, and responsive customer service. Working with Crisa Middle East Offshore Sal offers exposure to regional operations, cross-border collaboration, and a dynamic growth environment in the consumer goods sector. Role Description The Vice President of Finance is a full-time, remote role responsible for overseeing the financial strategy and performance of Crisa Middle East Offshore Sal and its affiliated operations. This role includes leading financial planning and budgeting processes, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, and monitoring key performance indicators to support strategic decision-making. The Vice President of Finance will review and analyze financial statements, manage cash flow and capital allocation, and implement controls and policies to maintain compliance and mitigate risk. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with senior leadership on long-term financial goals, guiding local finance teams across different countries, supporting audits, and identifying opportunities to improve profitability and operational efficiency. The role also involves preparing presentations and financial insights for executive and board-level reviews. Qualifications Strong finance and financial planning skills, including budgeting, forecasting, and long-term strategic financial management. Proficiency in preparing and interpreting financial statements and financial reporting for multi-entity or multinational operations. Advanced analytical skills, with the ability to translate data into clear insights and actionable recommendations. Extensive experience in corporate finance leadership, preferably within manufacturing, FMCG, or the F&B industry. Demonstrated experience in cash flow management, risk management, internal controls, and compliance with international accounting standards. Proven ability to lead and develop distributed finance teams, and to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of French or Arabic is an advantage. Relevant academic background such as a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business; professional certifications (e.g., CPA, ACCA, CFA) are beneficial.

Handle sensitive records according to access procedures. Entry-Level Qualifications Comfort using email, web tools, and basic office software. New team members are expected to follow established workflows, communicate blockers early, and seek feedback when learning unfamiliar tasks.
